58121.description:
Based on the erotic game by POISON.

The tutors of the main character, Masato, are "the sexually vicious sisters" he had known since childhood! Haruna Shinjo, the celebrity older sister, combines brains, a fine pair of eyebrows, and the worst kind of personality. Serina Shinjo, a college student with a selfish personality and body, is full of gaps. He is constantly mistreated by both of them, and is already fed up with his life. Then one day, Masato meets Sakiko Ichinose, the owner of the secret club "Gentildonna" and is handed a hypnosis device. 58122.description:
Based on the erotic doujin game by capture1.

Yuina is in love with her blood brother. One day, a mysterious voice leads her to a strange place. She is attacked by a man without knowing why, and she is in desperate need of help. But then, a ghostly succubus appears with a light and saves her! The succubus possesses Yuina's body and starts to attack her sexually. The mysterious succubus, who is not bothered by the flustered, naive Yuina, squeezes every man she can get her hands on. What will happen to Yuina in the world of succubus? I want to go home...... to my brother...... I wanted to "connect" with my beloved brother! I've been "connected" to a lecherous succubus! But this is just the way it is.......

58123.description:
Based on the erotic game by LiLiM DARKNESS.

Childhood friends Rio and Mamoru. Although they know each other's feelings, their unclear and ambiguous relationship leads them to despair....... Rio becomes involved in idol activities after accidentally participating in a beauty contest. Mamoru is warned that Rio is a prize for "Sacrifice", a way of passing the time for the black-hearted and powerful. To protect Rio, Mamoru decides to get involved as a part-timer and participant, but he is unable to tell Rio about the true situation. He was trying his best to protect her, despite her confusion and suspicions. However...... The reality that confronts him...... Mamoru is shown a scene he does not want to believe or see. With a desperate cry, a naked Rio reaches out her hand for help. Mamoru was unable to grasp her hand......

58178.description:
In a town of South-East Asia, at night, a Yakuza is facing a bloody conflict with local gangs. During the fight, he encounters with a ghost called Krasue (pronounced Gasoo), a flying woman head with her guts exposed, and is followed by her because of his blood's taste. Their battle eventually leads them to the depth of a dark and damp maze-like jungle, where boundaries between humans, animals and ghost seem to fade. With a howling noise, ”BOY MEETS GIRL” metamorphoses into ”Encounter with another species”.

(Source: New Chitose Airport International Animation Festival)

58197.description:
In the near future, a unique disease has swept across the planet: a virus that transforms humans into cats! And the horde is expanding, since if these adorable kitties snuggle with a human, the human is transformed into yet another cat. A small group of cat-loving survivors is trying to escape the madness, but how can you defend yourself against a threat you just want to cuddle and pet?! This wild new take on a post-apocalyptic survival tale will make you roll over and purr with delight!

(Source: Seven Seas Entertainment)

58198.description:
Eita Hoshizora is an 18-year-old college student who has just entered university. From an early age he exceled in singing, but a certain incident makes him unable to sing in front of others.

One day, his twin sister Karina Hoshizora, a top idol,asks him to stand on stage in her place. Unable to turn down her selfish sister's request, Eita acts by pretending to be her... but ends up upsetting her sponsors and in a situation where she could be kicked out of the entertainment world! Eita struggles to regain her position as a top idol in the special world of show business, but...

In this coming-of-age idol comedy, a sister and brother switch places and live as idols!

(Source: Nautiljon & Official Site, Edited)
